sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vehicles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "make" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "plate" TEXT NULL, "vin" TEXT NULL, "vehicle_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (vehicle_type IN ('car', 'van', 'motorcycle', 'truck', 'other')), "is_business" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_business" IN (0, 1)), "fuel_kind_default" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (fuel_kind_default IN ('petrol', 'diesel', 'lpg', 'cng', 'electric', 'hybrid', 'other')), "tank_capacity_ml" INTEGER CHECK (tank_capacity_ml IS NULL OR tank_capacity_ml > 0), "purchase_date" TEXT NULL, "purchase_odometer_m" INTEGER NULL, "purchase_price_minor" INTEGER NULL, "purchase_price_currency" TEXT CHECK (purchase_price_currency IS NULL OR length(purchase_price_currency) = 3), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'sold')), "sold_on" TEXT NULL, "sold_price_minor" INTEGER NULL, "sold_price_currency" TEXT CHECK (sold_price_currency IS NULL OR length(sold_price_currency) = 3), "expected_annual_m" INTEGER NULL, "colour" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "notifications_muted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("notifications_muted" IN (0, 1)), "currency" TEXT CHECK (currency IS NULL OR length(currency) = 3), "distance_unit" TEXT CHECK (distance_unit IN ('km', 'mi')), "volume_unit" TEXT CHECK (volume_unit IN ('l', 'gal_us', 'gal_uk')), "consumption_unit" TEXT CHECK (consumption_unit IN ('l_100km', 'km_l', 'mpg_us', 'mpg_uk', 'kwh_100km', 'mi_kwh')), "notice_distance_m" INTEGER NULL, "notice_days" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "service_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('oil_and_filter', 'air_filter', 'cabin_filter', 'fuel_filter', 'spark_plugs', 'timing_belt', 'brake_pads_check', 'brake_pads_front', 'brake_pads_rear', 'brake_fluid', 'coolant', 'transmission_fluid', 'wheel_alignment', 'tyre_rotate', 'tyre_replace', 'battery', 'wipers', 'inspection', 'registration', 'insurance_renewal', 'ac_service', 'chain_lube', 'chain_and_sprockets', 'valve_clearance', 'fork_oil', 'reduction_gearbox_oil', 'battery_12v', 'custom')), "label" TEXT NULL, "interval_distance_m" INTEGER CHECK (interval_distance_m IS NULL OR interval_distance_m > 0), "interval_distance_unit" TEXT CHECK (interval_distance_unit IN ('km', 'mi')), "interval_months" INTEGER CHECK (interval_months IS NULL OR interval_months > 0), "target_odometer_m" INTEGER NULL, "target_date" TEXT NULL, "baseline_date" TEXT NULL, "baseline_odometer_m" INTEGER NULL, "notice_distance_m" INTEGER NULL, "notice_days" INTEGER NULL, "is_tracked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tracked" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "notify" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("notify" IN (0, 1)), "priority" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (priority IN ('safety', 'normal', 'low')), "rollover" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (rollover IN ('from_actual', 'from_due')), "repeats" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("repeats" IN (0, 1)), "snoozed_until" TEXT NULL, "snooze_until_odometer_m" INTEGER NULL, "snooze_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (id = 'settings'), "created_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "language" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (language IN ('system', 'en', 'de', 'fr', 'fa', 'ar', 'ckb')), "calendar" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (calendar IN ('gregorian', 'persian')), "numerals" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (numerals IN ('auto', 'latin', 'arabic_indic', 'extended_arabic_indic')), "first_day_of_week" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (first_day_of_week BETWEEN 1 AND 7), "theme" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (theme IN ('system', 'light', 'dark')), "currency_default" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(currency_default) = 3), "currency_display" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (currency_display IN ('none', 'toman')), "distance_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (distance_unit IN ('km', 'mi')), "volume_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (volume_unit IN ('l', 'gal_us', 'gal_uk')), "consumption_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (consumption_unit IN ('l_100km', 'km_l', 'mpg_us', 'mpg_uk', 'kwh_100km', 'mi_kwh')), "notice_distance_m" INTEGER NULL, "notice_days" INTEGER NULL, "notification_time_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (notification_time_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "quiet_hours_from_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quiet_hours_from_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "quiet_hours_to_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quiet_hours_to_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "weekdays_only" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("weekdays_only" IN (0, 1)), "notify_service" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("notify_service" IN (0, 1)), "notify_odometer" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("notify_odometer" IN (0, 1)), "notify_backup" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("notify_backup" IN (0, 1)), "active_vehicle_id" TEXT NULL, "onboarding_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("onboarding_done" IN (0, 1)), "last_backup_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "last_backup_reminder_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "service_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurred_on" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (occurred_on GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'), "odometer_m" INTEGER CHECK (odometer_m IS NULL OR odometer_m >= 0), "odometer_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (odometer_unit IN ('km', 'mi')), "odometer_estimated" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("odometer_estimated" IN (0, 1)), "cost_estimated" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("cost_estimated" IN (0, 1)), "vendor" TEXT NULL, "invoice_ref" TEXT NULL, "warranty_until" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "service_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "service_record_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES service_records (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "service_item_id" TEXT REFERENCES service_items (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor >= 0), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(currency) = 3), "part_number" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trips" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NULL, "purpose" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (purpose IN ('business', 'commute', 'personal', 'other')), "started_on" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (started_on GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'), "ended_on" TEXT NULL, "start_odometer_m" INTEGER NULL, "end_odometer_m" INTEGER NULL, "manual_distance_m" INTEGER CHECK (manual_distance_m IS NULL OR manual_distance_m >= 0), "odometer_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (odometer_unit IN ('km', 'mi')), "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fill_ups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurred_on" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (occurred_on GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'), "odometer_m" INTEGER CHECK (odometer_m IS NULL OR odometer_m >= 0), "odometer_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (odometer_unit IN ('km', 'mi')), "fuel_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (fuel_kind IN ('petrol', 'diesel', 'lpg', 'cng', 'electric', 'hybrid', 'other')), "quantity_ml" INTEGER CHECK (quantity_ml IS NULL OR quantity_ml > 0), "quantity_g" INTEGER CHECK (quantity_g IS NULL OR quantity_g > 0), "energy_wh" INTEGER CHECK (energy_wh IS NULL OR energy_wh > 0), "quantity_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (quantity_unit IN ('l', 'gal_us', 'gal_uk')), "total_cost_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_cost_minor >= 0), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(currency) = 3), "is_full_tank" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_full_tank" IN (0, 1)), "chain_broken" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("chain_broken" IN (0, 1)), "grade" TEXT NULL, "station" TEXT NULL, "trip_id" TEXT REFERENCES trips (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "trip_id" TEXT REFERENCES trips (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "occurred_on" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (occurred_on GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'), "category" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('insurance', 'tax_registration', 'parking', 'toll', 'fine', 'wash', 'tyre_storage', 'accessories', 'finance', 'other')), "label" TEXT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(currency) = 3), "covers_from" TEXT NULL, "covers_to" TEXT NULL, "odometer_m" INTEGER CHECK (odometer_m IS NULL OR odometer_m >= 0), "odometer_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (odometer_unit IN ('km', 'mi')), "vendor" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "odometer_readings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurred_on" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (occurred_on GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'), "odometer_m" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (odometer_m >= 0), "odometer_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (odometer_unit IN ('km', 'mi')), "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('manual', 'fillup', 'service', 'expense', 'trip_start', 'trip_end', 'import')), "source_id" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "odometer_corrections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "from_reading_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES odometer_readings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "previous_m" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (previous_m >= 0), "new_m" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (new_m >= 0), "odometer_unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (odometer_unit IN ('km', 'mi')), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('cluster_replaced', 'rollover', 'typo_fix')), "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;
